\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{അടുത്ത} (aṭutta)}{അടുത്ത (aṭutta)}]{\ml{അടുത്ത} (aṭutta) — next, coming}

\label{lesson:ML-C179-atutta}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for once, then the Malayalam for to spend.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{അടുത്ത}}
\textbf{\ml{അടുത്ത}} — \emph{aṭutta} — \textquotedblleft{}next, coming\textquotedblright{}. The future adds \textbf{-\ml{ഉം}} (\emph{-uṁ}) to the verb: \textbf{\ml{പോകുക}} gives \textbf{\ml{പോകും}}. \textbf{\ml{അടുത്ത} \ml{ആഴ്ച} \ml{ഞാൻ} \ml{കൊല്ലത്ത്} \ml{പോകും}} — \emph{aṭutta āḻca ñān kollattŭ pōkuṁ} — \textquotedblleft{}Next week I will go to Kollam.\textquotedblright{}

\end{grammarlens}
